command:base=$(git merge-base HEAD origin/main); oversized=$({ git diff --name-only --diff-filter=AM "$base" -- packages/client/src; git ls-files -o --exclude-standard packages/client/src; } | sort -u | while read -r file; do [ -f "$file" ] && lines=$(wc -l < "$file") && [ "$lines" -gt 300 ] && echo "$file: $lines lines"; done); [ -z "$oversized" ] || { echo "$oversized"; echo "these files exceed the 300-line hard cap - split them, see .claude/rules/process-invariants.md"; exit 1; }

command:change=$(find openspec/changes -mindepth 1 -maxdepth 1 -type d ! -name archive)
since=$(git log --format='%H %s' | awk '$2 == "gnomish:" && $3 == "round" && $4 !~ /^implement#/ { print $1; exit }')
[ -n "$since" ] || since=$(git merge-base HEAD origin/main)
changed=$({ git diff --name-only "$since"; git ls-files -o --exclude-standard; } | sort -u | grep -v '^\.gnomish-task/' || true)
forbidden=$(printf '%s\n' "$changed" | grep -E '^(openspec/|\.gnomish/|\.github/|\.claude/|docs/adr/)' | grep -vxF "$change/tasks.md" || true)
[ -z "$forbidden" ] || { echo "$forbidden"; echo "the implement stage edits only packages/ and the checkboxes of $change/tasks.md - restore the files above with: git checkout $since -- <file>"; exit 1; }
dependencies=$(printf '%s\n' "$changed" | grep -E '(^|/)(package\.json|pnpm-lock\.yaml)$' || true)
if [ -n "$dependencies" ] && ! grep -qiE 'pnpm add|dependenc' "$change/tasks.md"; then echo "$dependencies"; echo "tasks.md asks for no new dependency - restore the files above with: git checkout $since -- <file>"; exit 1; fi

findings.message: date_selection_wall_clock.feature 'Wall-clock outcomes' (lines 15-28) drops the spec's status column: specs/date-selection/spec.md says 'THEN the moment is pinned to `<pinned>` with the status `<status>`' with a table column `status` (UNIQUE / GAP / AMBIGUOUS), and M3 requires 'pins 2026-03-08T07:30:00Z with GAP … with AMBIGUOUS … with UNIQUE (3 of 3)'. The feature table has only from|pinned|note and the step 'the moment is pinned to <pinned>'; date_selection_wall_clock.steps.tsx:62 checks only world.expectPinnedTo(variables.pinned). The status is never asserted although the scenario is tagged @M3. Add the status column and assert reference.wallClockStatus in the step.

date_selection_date_bar.feature:36 'Bar in each state' is tagged @FR8 @M4, but it asserts only that the previous-day, date and next-day buttons are present. M4 is about the bar label texts and the calendar week rows ('The bar reads `Sun, March 8` at 375 px … The March 2026 calendar has 5 week rows …'). Task 6.1 requires 'each scenario tagged only with the ids it asserts', and antipatterns.md says 'If the reference is not explicit, it does not exist.' Remove @M4 from this scenario.

findings.message: Files over the 200-line limit. CLAUDE.md Process Invariants: "Files must stay under 200 lines for AI context quality"; tasks.md header: "Keep every file under 200 lines." Violations: packages/client/src/test/features/date_selection/steps/date_selection_reference_moment.steps.tsx (280 lines), steps/date_selection_calendar.steps.tsx (275), steps/date_selection_e2e.steps.ts (265), steps/date_selection_layout_e2e.steps.ts (260), packages/client/src/model/referenceMoment.test.ts (255), and packages/client/src/test/features/main_page/steps/main_page_unit.steps.ts (203, pushed over the limit by task 6.4). Split them, e.g. into a shared world/helper plus several step files per scenario group, as was already done with dateSelectionWorld.tsx and date_selection_wall_clock.steps.tsx.

Hardcoded number in packages/client/src/views/shared/DateBar.tsx:65: `<Clock aria-hidden="true" size={16} />`. .claude/rules/code-style.md: "Numbers (except 0, 1, -1 in loops/indices)" must be extracted into a constant. The surrounding code already does this: LocationRow.tsx:99 uses `size={BADGE_ICON_SIZE_PX}`. Add a named constant (e.g. NOW_ICON_SIZE_PX) and use it.

Missing traceability in changed production code: packages/client/src/app/AppShell.tsx now passes `bottomBar={<DateBar />}` (task 5.4, FR8), but its JSDoc still lists only setup-app-shell-and-pages-deploy, add-main-page-scaffold and add-locations-via-search. tasks.md: "`Implements FR-X of select-date-with-calendar-and-now` in the JSDoc of new or changed production code". Add "FR8 of select-date-with-calendar-and-now (D7)" to the AppShell JSDoc.
